bookkeeping.rowText: The eight county doors (`_accounts`, `_bugs`, `redeem`, `standings`, `refusals`, `telemetry`, `stats`, `_multiplayer`) admit a localhost origin only when `ALLOW_LOCALHOST_ORIGINS` is exactly `1`, through one shared helper `functions/api/_cors.ts`; `RESEND_API_KEY` is read on no CORS path. Probe across all 22 CORS entry points: 134 of 782 rows off the rule before (Pages production 44, droplet 22, misspelled value 44, development with the mail key 22, the 308 redirect 2), 0 of 782 after; two manufactured defects caught (accept any value 44, remove the switch 134). The three local harnesses, six multiplayer specs and `assay-season-roll` pass the switch to the dev runs they start; `tl-02` asserts 403 without it and 204 with it; `.dev.vars` gitignored, `.dev.vars.example` tracked, the runbook says never on Pages. Implementer's locked batch: test:accounts 241, test:mp 528, test:stats 87+617+617+26, all rc 0; e2e 132 passed, 21 failed, every red reproduced on the cut `39f88d36f` by a control worktree and none a CORS refusal (F-LC2-13, the drain's inventory). Engine hash unchanged (functions, e2e and scripts are not engine inputs).
